spec.scene: A narrow wooden windowsill fills the small patch of ground, night-blue glass panes rising at the back edge. At the center sits a warm ceramic mug of tea, a thin curl of steam above it, a little larger than life. To its left, a tiny round lamp glows soft amber, lighting the wood in a warm pool. To the right, a small potted houseplant rests with drooping rounded leaves, half in shadow. Cool blue light from the panes meets the lamp's amber, and everything is still.
spec.title: A Quiet Night
spec.caption: A quiet night in, just me and a warm mug.
